results.name: Canvas has one library entry and direct still/video icons, no compulsory editorial copy
All seven icon centres align in a thinner rail; Interact comes first
Every tool opens and closes its own surface in one click without mutating the expression
Closing the Studio explicitly returns to the quiet canvas
Orbital drag changes yaw/pitch without a field force or document edit
Orbital pan and zoom share the saved camera and preserve working-plane settings
Axis targets and keyboard controls work without physics steps, target rebakes or reseeds
Camera tool has no duplicate persistent toolbar or instruction pill
Bottom-right XYZ values match the world-space pointer, not a corner status label
Library is a full page with image/name/subtitle cards, not a modal
Opening library clears field input and pauses its time without a reset
About and import/export live in the library; browsing does not change the expression
Returning from library restores exactly the camera and active expression
A running field pauses for library browsing and resumes without time catch-up
Modes open editable composition forks and retain the previous expression
Import adds a card without replacing the live expression
An imported ID conflict preserves both versions instead of overwriting current work
Expression name and subtitle are editable in the library with safe literal text
Expression export retains the compatible authoring envelope and the edited document
Narrow layout keeps controller, capture and transport without horizontal overflow
Library remains a scrollable single-column page on small screens
Touch orbit changes the view without placing objects or applying field forces
Storage-unavailable import remains in-session and offers honest portable export

environment: Chromium software WebGL; 2048-particle fixtures; declared storage double except explicit unavailable-storage case. Native state and trusted touch checked.
